retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, grid-based layout featuring ultra-condensed sans-serif and serif typography paired with a minimalist, rainbow-colored geometric piano key illustration on a matte black field.
triggerTerms: high contrast black and white music poster
excludeWhen: organic or fluid shapes are preferred

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tier horizontal composition on a black background. The top tier features tall, elegant serif display type. The middle tier splits between ultra-condensed sans-serif type on the left and a stylized rainbow piano keyboard on the right. The bottom tier is dominated by a single line of extremely tall, compressed sans-serif type spanning the full width.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical elongation of all typographic elements
High-contrast white-on-black text for maximum legibility
Geometric alignment of the rainbow graphic with the text blocks
Balanced distribution of visual weight between the graphic and the heavy type
coreInvariants: Spectrum-ordered (rainbow) vertical bars for the piano graphic

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The composition is divided into three distinct horizontal bands of roughly equal height, with text filling 75% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The rainbow piano key graphic in the center-right serves as the primary focal point against the monochrome text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down reading order, moving from the light serif at the top to the dense, heavy sans-serif at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space acts as a structural frame, separating the three horizontal tiers.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black background providing a stark, high-contrast field.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for all primary typographic elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant spectrum (green, yellow, orange, red, purple, blue) used exclusively for the piano key graphic.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Full saturation for the rainbow accents against a zero-value black and maximum-value white.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight in the sans-serif blocks
High stroke contrast in the top-tier serif block
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'J' in the top tier features a deep, circular hook
The 'O' and 'C' in the bottom tier are reduced to narrow vertical ovals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a delicate, spaced-out serif with a brutalist, compressed sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif style of the top tier.
Provides the necessary weight and density for the lower blocks.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid matte black background. In the center-right, place a minimalist graphic of 12 vertical piano keys. The keys should be colored in a rainbow sequence from left to right: green, lime, yellow, orange, red, magenta, purple, blue, cyan, green. The black keys should be simple black rectangular cutouts.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply white text in three tiers. Top tier: elegant high-contrast serif, widely spaced. Middle tier (left side): ultra-condensed sans-serif, two lines. Bottom tier: massive ultra-condensed sans-serif spanning the full width. All text must be vertically elongated.

verificationChecks: Are the piano keys in a rainbow sequence?
Is the typography extremely vertically compressed?
Are there three distinct horizontal bands of content?

adjustableVariables: Degree of vertical stretching in the fonts
Width of the piano key graphic
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
The exact spacing of the original letterforms

mustAchieve: Sharp, clean edges on all geometric shapes
Perfect vertical alignment of text blocks

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the rainbow piano keys are perfectly rectangular and aligned.
Check that the white text is not bleeding into the black background.
Verify that the serif and sans-serif fonts are distinct in their respective tiers.
Confirm the composition follows a strict horizontal grid.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Matte Black Background] + [3-Tier Horizontal Grid] + [Ultra-Condensed White Sans-Serif] + [High-Contrast Modern Serif] + [Rainbow Geometric Icon].
